jobs.descZh: 01 早期样机构建与装配工艺导入：亲自参与早期样机及后续试产阶段的构建、装配Fit Check和工艺验证。根据图纸、BOM及实物建立装配流程、工序分解、工具清单和阶段适用的关键工艺参数。识别装配顺序、工具可达性、线束走向及返工难点，记录实际版本、装配问题和构建结果，形成可复制的装配方法。02 DFM/DFA评审与问题闭环：与机械、电子及系统团队开展可制造性／可装配性评审，反馈装配干涉、线束损伤、安装公差、连接可靠性及可维护性问题。建立问题台账，推动临时围堵、根因分析、设计或工艺整改及效果验证。确保关键问题具有明确责任人、适用版本和关闭证据，按批准要求落实改善措施。03 装配夹治具设计、厂商协作与产线规划：负责装配定位、夹持、支撑、紧固及线束布置夹治具的需求定义和方案设计；结合构建数量、设计成熟度及操作安全，确定定位基准、夹持方式、精度／重复性和操作要求。能够独立完成常规装配夹治具的结构设计、3D模型及制造图纸；对于复杂或专业夹治具，可与外部设计／制作厂商合作，并主导技术要求、方案评审、图纸审核和变更控制。协同采购／供应链推进厂商选型及交付，跟踪制作与现场调试；制定验收要求，验证定位／夹持可靠性、装配质量、操作便利性、安全防护及适用的精度／重复性，并建立保养、易损件和版本管理要求。规划装配工位、物料流、现场安全及可扩展的产线Layout；早期采用受控、适用的夹治具方案，通过试产数据逐步完善节拍、工位平衡和产能规划。04 工艺文件、版本管理与人员培训：建立并维护SOP、工序检验要求、返工指导及控制计划，与QE协作完善SIP；将夹治具使用、点检和关键操作要求纳入作业文件。将已批准的工程变更、替代料和偏差落实到工艺文件及实际构建，确保设计版本、物料、夹治具／工具和作业文件一致。通过示范、实操培训和现场观察验证技师执行能力，依据设计变更及构建反馈受控修订作业指导。05 试产准备、制程质量与追溯协作：参与构建准备度评审、逐台物料放行和构建记录管理，确认装配工艺、装配夹治具、作业文件及人员操作能力满足阶段要求。与质量及测试团队协作处理制程和测试反馈的问题，提供装配工艺、实际版本及构建记录，支持缺陷定位并落实装配侧整改。与相关团队完善物料批次、产品序列号、软硬件版本及装配记录的关联追溯，支持试产数据分析和问题闭环。06 量产工艺固化与持续改善：持续跟进EVT、DVT、PVT及量产导入，依据验证结果逐步固化工艺窗口，推动NPI到量产的受控交接。分析装配不良、返工、报废、工时及直通合格率，区分来料、装配、产品设计、夹治具和测试方法问题。运用8D、5Why、SPC等适用工具改善良率、节拍和成本，并沉淀工艺及夹治具知识库；与SQE/QE、研发及供应链共同开展供应商工艺评审。
jobs.descEn: 01 Prototype Builds & Assembly Process Introduction: Participate personally in early prototype and pilot builds, assembly fit checks and process validation. Develop assembly flows, operation breakdowns, tool lists and stage-appropriate process parameters from drawings, BOMs and physical builds. Identify sequencing, tool-access, harness-routing and rework challenges; document actual configurations, build issues and results to establish repeatable assembly methods. 02 DFM/DFA Reviews & Issue Resolution: Work with mechanical, electronics and systems teams on design-for-manufacturing and design-for-assembly reviews, addressing interference, harness damage, installation tolerances, connection robustness and serviceability. Maintain an issue log and drive containment, root-cause analysis, design or process corrections and verification. Ensure clear ownership, applicable revisions and closure evidence, and implement approved corrective actions. 03 Assembly Jig & Fixture Design, Vendor Collaboration & Line Planning: Own requirements and concept design for assembly locating, clamping, support, fastening and harness-routing fixtures. Define locating datums, clamping methods, accuracy, repeatability and operating requirements based on build volumes, design maturity and operator safety. Independently design conventional assembly fixtures, including mechanical structures, 3D models and manufacturing drawings. For complex or specialized fixtures, collaborate with external design and fabrication vendors while leading technical requirements, concept reviews, drawing approval and change control. Work with Procurement and Supply Chain on vendor selection and delivery, following fabrication and on-site commissioning. Define acceptance requirements and verify locating and clamping reliability, assembly quality, usability, safeguarding and applicable accuracy/repeatability; establish maintenance, wear-part and revision-control requirements. Plan assembly workstations, material flow, workplace safety and scalable line layouts. Use controlled, fit-for-purpose fixtures for early builds and refine takt, workstation balance and capacity planning using pilot-build data. 04 Process Documentation, Change Control & Training: Create and maintain SOPs, in-process checks, rework instructions and control plans; collaborate with QE on SIPs. Incorporate fixture operation, routine checks and critical handling requirements into work instructions. Implement approved engineering changes, alternative-part use and deviations in documentation and actual builds, maintaining alignment across design revisions, materials, fixtures/tools and work instructions. Validate technician capability through demonstrations, practical training and observation; update instructions under change control following design changes and build feedback. 05 Pilot-build Readiness, Process Quality & Traceability: Support build-readiness reviews, unit-level material release and build records, ensuring assembly processes, assembly fixtures, work instructions and operator capability meet stage requirements. Collaborate with Quality and Test on issues reported during manufacturing and testing, providing assembly-process information, actual configurations and build records to support defect analysis and assembly-related corrective actions. Work with relevant teams to link material lots, product serial numbers, hardware/software revisions and assembly records, supporting pilot-build data analysis and issue closure. 06 Process Stabilization & Continuous Improvement: Support EVT, DVT, PVT and production introduction, stabilizing process windows using validated results and enabling a controlled NPI-to-production handover. Analyze assembly defects, rework, scrap, labor time and first-pass yield; distinguish incoming, assembly, product-design, fixture and test-method issues. Apply suitable tools such as 8D, 5 Whys and SPC to improve yield, takt and cost, and build a process and fixture knowledge base. Coordinate supplier process reviews with SQE/QE, R&D and Supply Chain.
requirementsZh: 教育与经验：本科及以上学历，机械、机电一体化、电子工程、机器人等相关专业；8年以上智能硬件或精密机电产品的PIE／制造工艺经验，具备从样机、试产到量产导入的实际项目经历。
现场动手与装配工艺能力：能够亲自参与样机构建，独立拆解装配流程、编写可执行SOP、制定工装需求并开展技师培训；具备精密装配、公差配合、线束布置、紧固及返工问题处理经验。
装配夹治具设计与厂商管理能力：具备装配夹治具从需求、方案、结构设计到制作、调试和验收的实际项目经验；能够独立设计常规夹治具，熟练使用SolidWorks、Creo或同类3D CAD工具输出模型和制造图纸，掌握定位／夹持、公差配合、材料选型、可制造性及操作安全等基本原则。
能够向外部厂商提出清晰技术要求，审核复杂夹治具方案及图纸，协调设计变更、制作进度和现场整改，并以实际验证结果完成验收；不局限于提出需求或跟进采购。
技术与制造基础：能够阅读机械图纸和BOM，理解基本电气接口、线束及机电集成要求；熟悉CNC、注塑、线束、PCBA等主要制造工艺，能够识别与装配相关的关键风险；具备工位设计、产线Layout和节拍平衡能力。
质量与变更控制：具备问题分析、围堵和改善验证能力，能够使用8D、5Why及适用的数据分析工具；理解ECN、版本基线、偏差、返工和追溯管理，能够与研发、QE/SQE及测试团队协作闭环。
英文与跨团队沟通：英语可作为工作语言，能够阅读英文技术资料，参与工艺评审和技术讨论，并编写或转化为现场可执行的作业指导；具备跨研发、质量、测试及供应链团队的沟通与推动能力。
早期项目适应性：能够在资料不完整、资源有限、设计迭代较快的阶段建立受控的阶段工艺，区分临时方案与长期方案；具备风险升级、责任协调及执行推动能力，重视操作安全、记录完整性和结果可验证性。
requirementsEn: Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree or above in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Robotics or a related field. 8+ years of PIE/manufacturing-process experience in smart hardware or precision electromechanical products, including practical prototype-to-production projects.

Hands-on Builds & Assembly Process Capability: Able to participate personally in prototype builds, develop assembly flows and practical SOPs, define tooling requirements and train technicians. Experienced in precision assembly, tolerance interfaces, harness routing, fastening and rework.

Assembly Jig & Fixture Design & Vendor Management: Hands-on experience taking assembly fixtures from requirements and concept/mechanical design through fabrication, commissioning and acceptance. Able to independently design conventional fixtures and use SolidWorks, Creo or equivalent 3D CAD tools to produce models and manufacturing drawings. Understands locating/clamping, tolerance interfaces, material selection, manufacturability and operator safety.

Able to provide clear specifications to external vendors, review complex fixture concepts and drawings, coordinate design changes, fabrication schedules and on-site corrections, and complete acceptance based on verified results. Capability must extend beyond requesting tooling or tracking procurement.

Technical & Manufacturing Fundamentals: Able to read mechanical drawings and BOMs and understand basic electrical interfaces, harnesses and electromechanical integration. Familiar with major manufacturing processes such as CNC machining, injection molding, harness manufacturing and PCBA, and able to identify assembly-related risks. Skilled in workstation design, line layout and takt balancing.

Quality & Change Control: Skilled in problem analysis, containment and verification using 8D, 5 Whys and appropriate data-analysis tools. Understands ECNs, configuration baselines, deviations, rework and traceability, and can collaborate with R&D, QE/SQE and Test on issue closure.

English & Cross-functional Communication: Able to use English as a working language, read English technical documentation, participate in process reviews and technical discussions, and develop practical work instructions. Able to coordinate and drive actions across R&D, Quality, Test and Supply Chain.

Adaptability in Early-stage Programs: Able to establish controlled, stage-appropriate processes with incomplete documentation, limited resources and rapid design changes. Distinguishes temporary measures from long-term solutions; demonstrates clear risk escalation, ownership coordination and execution skills, with a strong focus on safety, complete records and verifiable outcomes.

jobs.descEn: Demand forecasting & procurement planning: R&D procurement — Maintain regular communication with Hardware R&D, Project Management, Sourcing, and other stakeholders to align on material demand forecasts and procurement plans. Production procurement — Work closely with Manufacturing and CM/EMS partners to support production demand forecasting, build plans, and material procurement planning. Order execution & management (ensure on-time, in-full delivery): Confirm procurement requirements end-to-end with internal requesters and suppliers, including material name/specification, supplier, pricing, quantity, and requested lead time/delivery date. Issue purchase orders and ensure accuracy of all PO details (part number, description, price, quantity, etc.). Communicate, confirm, and track delivery dates. Communicate, confirm, and track delivery methods and logistics arrangements. Manage engineering changes (ECO/ECN) and other order changes; assess impact on in-transit and future demand and drive mitigation actions. Ensure closed-loop communication with internal stakeholders and suppliers. Reconciliation and payment coordination. Close purchase orders; for partial deliveries, confirm backorders or cancellations and close outstanding lines accordingly. Quality issues & reverse logistics: Coordinate timely resolution of quality issues, including return/exchange processes for defective items, and arrange appropriate reverse logistics. Supplier delivery performance management: Partner with Sourcing to lead supplier performance tracking and improvement (e.g., OTD, lead time, MOQ, capacity readiness). Data management, process improvement & systems: Maintain and manage supplier, pricing, purchase order, and logistics information; archive procurement documents and contracts; support reporting and data analysis. Contribute to (and, when needed, lead) process design and optimization across the end-to-end flow (Requirement → PO → Logistics). Support evaluation and implementation of ERP or order management systems when required. Indirect materials (MRO): Source suppliers for indirect materials (MRO), conduct RFQs/price comparisons, and execute purchasing and delivery. Other tasks: Complete other assignments as required by the manager.

jobs.descZh: 1. 寻源与策略管理：建立具身智能与人形机器人行业的供应市场信息渠道；调研并开发符合尖端机器人技术要求的优质供应商资源库。负责机器人核心品类（如执行器和电机等机电模组、电池、传感器、算力模块、电子件、结构件等）采购策略的制定与执行。定期分析行业趋势、供应链资讯与成本情报，确保在快速更迭的机器人供应链中保持竞争优势。2. 技术协同与供应商开发：建立机器人关键部件的资源选型库，并根据供应市场及技术发展持续优化；与研发及供应商协同推荐选用关键部件，并协调测试和验证过程。作为采购方技术权威，在方案设计初期介入（ESI），主导全球研发团队与供应商的协同，确保产品的可制造性（DFM）与可采购性（DFP）。驱动供应商深度参与人形机器人核心零部件的联合设计与开发；管理样件开发全过程(包含打样/测试/承认等过程），确保技术指标的最终实现。主导供应商制造工艺路径及质量体系的技术评估与调研，确保其具备执行人形机器人高精度零部件开发的能力。建立机器人复杂模组的“理应成本”模型；主导商务谈判，确保质量、产能、价格及技术协议（SOW）的达成。3. 供应商全生命周期管理：负责供应商全生命周期管理（SQCDS），包括准入审核、绩效考核（SCOR）及长期合作伙伴关系维护。负责保密协议、框架采购协议、技术协议等协议的签订与管理。负责品类整体“健康度”；协调解决技术、质量、交付异常，确保研发与生产任务按时达成。管理从需求确认、订单下达到交期跟踪、工程变更（ECO）及付款执行的全流程工作。4. 全球协作与风险控制：具备全球化视野，作为美国总部与全球供应链之间的战略纽带，确保技术需求和项目进度的无缝同步。系统性识别并管理供应链风险（如地缘政治、单一供货源、产能瓶颈等），并制定相应的应对策略。
jobs.descEn: 1. Strategic Sourcing & Management: Supply base Development — Establish information channels for the Embodied AI and Humanoid Robotics supply market; identify and develop a high-quality supplier base that aligns with cutting-edge robotics technology. Category Strategy — Formulate and execute procurement strategies for core robotics categories (e.g., electromechanical modules such as actuators and high-torque motors, batteries, sensors, computing modules, electronic parts and structural parts). Supply Market Trends — Regularly analyze robotics industry trends, supply chain information and cost intelligence to maintain a competitive edge in the rapidly evolving robotics supply chain. 2. Technical Synergy & Supplier development: Component Selection Library — Establish and maintain a Key Component Selection Library for robotics; continuously optimize the library based on market and technology trends. Collaborate with R&D to recommend optimal components and coordinate the testing and validation processes. Early Supply Involvement (ESI) — Act as the sourcing technical authority; Drive Early Supply Involvement by collaborating with global R&D teams and suppliers during the concept and design stage to ensure Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Procurement (DFP). Supplier components development — Drive suppliers to participate in the joint design and development of core humanoid robot components; manage the prototyping and testing and qualification process to ensure technical specifications are realized. Supplier Technical Evaluation — Lead technical audits and survey of supplier manufacturing roadmaps and quality systems to ensure they can execute the high-precision requirements of humanoid robotics. Cost Modeling & Business Negotiation — Establish “Should-Cost” models for complex robotic modules; lead negotiations to secure quality, capacity, competitive pricing, and technical agreements (SOW). 3. Supplier lifecycle Management: Supplier management — Lead the full lifecycle of suppliers management (SQCDS: Safety, Quality, Cost, Delivery, Service), including supplier audit and qualification, performance management (SCOR), and longterm partnership maintenance. Contract management for NDA, Master Purchase Agreements (MPA/MSA), SOW, and other agreements.
